id: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad! (1988)
title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
about: Bumbling cop Frank Drebin tries to stop an assassination of the Queen at a baseball game.
cue: Serve the snacks when Frank goes undercover as the umpire.
